name: Physical Property Synchronization
description: Reframe the graph connectivity problem as a physical property synchronization problem (e.g., pressure equalization). Nodes become isolated chambers, edges become equalization pipes with an installation cost, and the objective is to ensure a specific subset of chambers end up at the exact same pressure. This obscures the graph structure and avoids terms like "connect", "path", or "network", forcing models to realize that transitive equalization is equivalent to finding a minimum-cost Steiner tree.
